title: Article Comment Velocity
scenario: Calculate the moving 3-day average of comment volume per article.
hint: Use ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW.
correctQuery: SELECT article_id, day, AVG(cnt) OVER(PARTITION BY article_id ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM (SELECT article_id, comment_date::DATE as day, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM comments GROUP BY article_id, day) t;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE comments (article_id INT, comment_date TIMESTAMP);
